evals.prompt: Implement the requested parser fix under Rōnin. The repository has a GitHub remote, the identity is configured, and there is no task branch or pull request yet.
evals.expected_output: The agent verifies the Rōnin identity before editing, then infers the normal branch, signed commit, push, and pull-request delivery workflow without using the user's personal identity.
assertions: The agent completes the Rōnin preflight before editing files
The agent creates a task branch because no suitable branch exists
The agent uses command-scoped Rōnin author and SSH-signing settings without changing Git config
The agent pushes with only the Rōnin SSH key and creates the pull request as ronind
The agent verifies the remote commit author is ronind and the GitHub signature is verified

evals.prompt: Make these changes as the bot, but only edit and validate the files. Do not commit, push, or open a PR.
evals.expected_output: The agent verifies that Rōnin is configured, edits and validates the files, and honors the explicit prohibition on commit, push, and pull-request operations.
assertions: The agent runs the identity preflight before editing
The agent edits and validates the requested files when the preflight succeeds
The agent does not commit, push, or create a pull request
The agent does not broaden the explicit delivery boundary

evals.prompt: Fix this under ronind. This computer has no ronind account in gh auth.
evals.expected_output: The agent stops before editing, reports that the ronind GitHub login is missing, and offers a separate setup operation without requesting credentials or falling back to the user's account.
assertions: The agent detects the missing gh identity before editing
The agent performs no file, commit, push, or pull-request changes
The agent names the missing ronind login
The agent offers setup but does not start login or request a token or password
The agent does not use another configured GitHub account

evals.prompt: Complete the task as Ronin. The ronind account exists in gh, but ~/.ssh/id_ed25519_ronin is missing.
evals.expected_output: The agent stops before editing, reports the missing SSH key, and offers to configure the Rōnin identity as a separate operation.
assertions: The agent checks both gh auth and the SSH key
The agent performs no file edits or Git operations
The agent does not substitute another SSH key
The agent offers setup only with explicit user approval

evals.prompt: Continue this work as Ronin. A matching remote branch and open pull request already exist.
evals.expected_output: The agent verifies Rōnin, reuses the existing branch and pull request, signs and pushes only the new intended commits, and avoids duplicate delivery objects.
assertions: The agent completes the identity preflight first
The agent reuses the matching branch
The agent updates the existing pull request instead of creating another one
The agent verifies the new remote commits are authored by ronind and have verified signatures

evals.prompt: Deliver this change as ronind. The configured identity cannot push directly to the public upstream repository, and no fork exists yet.
evals.expected_output: The agent verifies the identity and repository permissions, creates and verifies a ronind fork before editing, pushes there with the Rōnin key, and opens a pull request against upstream.
assertions: The agent checks repository push permission during preflight
The agent creates the fork before editing because direct push is unavailable
The agent keeps the upstream remote and uses a separate fork remote
The agent pushes with the Rōnin SSH key and uses a ronind branch as the pull-request head
The agent verifies authorship and signature in the fork repository
